name: Paras Healthcare
summary: Operator of 8 Paras Health tertiary/quaternary hospitals (2,211 beds) across North India, Bihar, Jharkhand and J&K.
financials: FY26 revenue ₹1,606 Cr (+24%), PAT ₹44 Cr after losses in FY24 and FY25; borrowings ₹854 Cr plus ₹540 Cr leases.
positives: Revenue +24% in FY26; Q1 FY27 revenue ₹470 Cr vs ₹368 Cr a year earlier
Large regional bed base with ~74% revenue from CONGOR specialties
₹375 Cr of the fresh issue goes to debt repayment
red_flags: P/E ~160x vs listed peers 43–116x on thin FY26 profit
66% of the issue is OFS (promoter ₹300 Cr, Commelina ₹650 Cr)
RHP flags untraceable historical corporate records and RoC filings
